title: Delayed final payment
text: A worker who has completed employment may document unpaid wages, request an itemized calculation, and use the applicable labour grievance channel. Preserve the offer letter, payslips, attendance records, and written payment requests.

title: Online account takeover
text: If an online account is taken over, immediately preserve screenshots and transaction records, change access credentials through a trusted device, notify the service provider, and report financial loss to the relevant cybercrime channel.

title: Immediate personal safety
text: A credible threat of physical harm requires immediate safety planning. Move to a safe location, contact local emergency services, preserve threatening messages, and seek support from a trusted person or qualified professional.

title: Defective product complaint
text: For a defective product, retain the invoice, warranty, photographs, support correspondence, and repair history. Send a written request describing the defect and the remedy requested before using the applicable consumer grievance process.

title: Rental deposit disagreement
text: For a rental deposit dispute, preserve the lease, move-in photographs, payment proof, inspection notes, and messages with the owner. Request an itemized explanation for deductions in writing.
